data.summary: The agent directory contains the core LangGraph agent implementation, command-line interface, configuration settings, and experimental tools for both raw SQL (Arm A) and semantic layer (Arm B) approaches.

file_insights.name: __init__.py
file_insights.detailed_description: Empty package initialization file for the agent module directory.

file_insights.name: cli.py
file_insights.summary: Command-line interface for running the interactive agent.
file_insights.source_summary: Defines the main CLI entry point that sets up argument parsing for semantic vs raw arms and executes the agent.
file_insights.detailed_description: Provides a command-line interface to run the interactive agent with configurable experimental arms.
responsibilities: Initialize and run the agent loop

file_insights.name: config.py
file_insights.summary: Configuration and environment setup for the agent.
file_insights.source_summary: Sets up project root paths and configures environment settings for the agent.
file_insights.detailed_description: Centralizes configuration, environment variable loading, and network settings for IPv4 preference.
responsibilities: Configure path constants and network settings

file_insights.name: graph.py
file_insights.summary: LangGraph agent core logic and execution loop.
file_insights.source_summary: Implements the LangGraph agent state machine, retry logic, model pools, and tracing.
file_insights.detailed_description: Core LangGraph agent implementation managing the tool-calling loop, retries, and human-in-the-loop clarifications.
responsibilities: Build and compile the agent graph
Manage LLM invocation with backoff and rate limits

file_insights.name: prompts.py
file_insights.source_summary: Contains prompt templates and instructions for the chatbot assistant.
file_insights.detailed_description: Stores system prompts and instructions shared across experimental arms for the data analysis assistant.
responsibilities: Define system prompts and behavioral rules for the agent

file_insights.name: tools_common.py
file_insights.summary: Common tools shared across agent arms.
file_insights.source_summary: Defines the submit_answer tool with various status types.
file_insights.detailed_description: Defines the common submit_answer tool used by the agent to return structured responses to users.
responsibilities: Define the submit_answer tool interface and parameters

file_insights.name: tools_raw.py
file_insights.summary: Raw text-to-SQL tools for experimental Arm A.
file_insights.source_summary: Provides raw SQL query execution and schema inspection tools for Arm A.
file_insights.detailed_description: Implements generic text-to-SQL tools querying Trino for Arm A (raw text-to-SQL experiment arm).
responsibilities: Provide raw table listing, description, and SQL execution tools

file_insights.name: tools_semantic.py
file_insights.summary: Semantic layer tools for experimental Arm B.
file_insights.source_summary: Provides metric listing and metric description tools backed by the semantic layer.
file_insights.detailed_description: Implements governed semantic layer tools for Arm B where the model names metrics and dimensions instead of writing SQL.
responsibilities: Define semantic dimensions and metric tools
Build and execute queries via the semantic layer interface

file_insights.name: usage.py
file_insights.summary: API usage tracking and rate-limiting utility.
file_insights.source_summary: Handles loading, saving, and checking API usage statistics and model capacity.
file_insights.detailed_description: Tracks daily API usage counts and model availability against rate limits, persisting state to disk.
responsibilities: Track per-day API call counts per model
Manage rate limits and model availability status
